goServerChecks.realtime-events.no-signal-crosses-organi: It reads the Go server's own event stream (GET /auth/events). The TypeScript server's live updates are Convex subscriptions, scoped by the claims of a Convex token, which this suite cannot open as a stream.
goServerChecks.realtime-events.revocation-and-removal-c: The TypeScript server cannot pass it: a Convex subscription stays open until its 10-minute Convex token expires or is minted again, whatever was signed out, revoked or removed.
goServerChecks.realtime-events.slow-client-cut-off-alon: It needs the Go server's bounded per-stream buffer. On the TypeScript server, Convex serves the subscriptions and its own buffering is not varlatchd's to bound.
